metadata.recipient_description: three retail clients in a muni ladder program

items.communication: Quick note from Priya at the Westfield office: the muni ladder we set up is paying as scheduled and the next coupon lands June 1. Call me with any questions. - Priya Raman, Registered Representative

gold_label.rationale: Three retail recipients: correspondence. A factual servicing update with no claims.

violations.explanation: The member firm is never named.

model_verdict.rationale: Correspondence must name the member firm under (d)(3); this message names only the rep and an office.

items.communication: Hi Tom, the Lakemont Example Balanced Fund returned 14% last year, a great fit for your IRA. Let me know and I'll place the order. Sam Ortiz, Lakemont Example Securities LLC, Member FINRA/SIPC

violations.explanation: Fund performance without standardized returns, sales charge or expense ratio.
